data.long_meaning: The name Lottie is derived from the Old English word 'lott,' which means 'little' or 'compact.' In the Middle Ages, it was used as a pet form of various female names beginning with 'L.' Today, Lottie is primarily used as a feminine given name, often associated with lovability and cuteness. The name Lottie carries the meaning “Little one, compact” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lottie usually hope their child will grow to embody little one, compact and live with faith, good character and purpose.
